revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing a covered loading area. Off-axis corridor view at near-medium distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Wide concrete surface with dull stone flooring, partial shadow from nearby structure, clear subject detail. Visible subject is an adult with a curvy build wearing a burgundy coat over purple and gray casual clothing with straight-leg trousers, seated on the floor while sorting a small work item, pelvis grounded, head and chest raised. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture. Include dock equipment, carts, a few tools and boxes placed naturally in the background. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
